title: High Availability by Layer — Scope & Architecture Map
purpose: Visualizes Defense-in-Depth High Availability across all 5 infrastructure layers: DNS Anycast, Multi-Region Interconnect, Regional Compute MIGs, Dual-Region Cloud Storage, and Multi-Region Cloud Spanner Paxos.
routing_rationale: System availability is only as strong as its weakest link; true high availability requires redundancy, automated failover, and isolation at every single layer of the stack.

nodes.label: Cloud DNS Anycast Routing
nodes.detail: Anycast BGP routes client to closest healthy edge PoP worldwide with 100% SLA.

nodes.label: Dual Cloud Interconnects
nodes.detail: Dual redundant 10Gbps links across two distinct metropolitan colocation facilities.

nodes.label: Regional MIG (3 Zones)
nodes.detail: Spreads instances evenly across zones a, b, and c with auto-healing health checks.

nodes.label: Dual-Region Cloud Storage
nodes.detail: Replicates objects across us-central1 and us-east4 with turbo replication.

nodes.label: Cloud Spanner Multi-Region
nodes.detail: Replicated across 3 regions with Paxos consensus, surviving full regional loss.

steps.title: Ingress Redundancy
steps.action: Anycast DNS and dual interconnects guarantee zero-downtime client packet ingress.
steps.why_traversal: Eliminates single point of failure before traffic reaches cloud compute.

steps.title: Compute & Data Resiliency
steps.action: Regional MIG distributes traffic across 3 zones; data persists across dual-region storage and Spanner.
steps.why_traversal: Ensures entire physical datacenter loss results in zero data loss and zero downtime.

scenarios.label: Single-Zone Cloud SQL Bottleneck
scenarios.root_cause: System used multi-zone compute but pointed to a single-zone non-HA database.
scenarios.diverted_path: Zone outage takes down database; all compute pods crash due to database timeouts.
scenarios.recovery: Upgrade database to Cloud SQL High Availability with automatic failover replica.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Visualizes Defense-in-Depth High Availability across all 5 infrastructure layers: DNS Anycast, Multi-Region Interconnect, Regional Compute MIGs, Dual-Region Cloud Storage, and Multi-Region Cloud Spanner Paxos.
